pilot_prompt: Create a four-second cinematic transition using winter-v6.png as the exact first frame and autumn-v6.png as the exact last frame. 0–1s: camera moves forward-left into the snowy valley; the stationary blue hat passes completely beyond the right edge without changing shape. 1–1.8s: enter low cloud. 1.8–2.2s: opaque cloud covers the whole frame and conceals a cut to the separate autumn location while keeping apparent forward momentum. 2.2–3.6s: reveal the warm autumn valley first, then uncover the stationary original red cloche in its approved right-side position. Decelerate and hold the exact autumn composition from3.6–4s. Preserve silhouettes, materials, colours and decorations. Never show both hats together, morph, rotate, duplicate or ground them. No visible landscape melting, optical distortion, added objects or text.

integration_contract.trigger: Pilot: forward vertical wheel seeks a paused clip; button plays the remaining flight. Main site keeps existing still navigation.
integration_contract.layers: DOM title and menu above one muted playsinline video, approved stills underneath. No text burned into video.
integration_contract.caption: Fade out 140ms at departure, restore 180ms after arrival.
integration_contract.readiness: Decode target still first. Retain source until first displayed video frame. Preload nearest clip only.
integration_contract.completion: Target still behind last video frame. Check the seam visually, then remove video.
integration_contract.fallback: Auto failure uses the decoded autumn still. Initial scrub failure retains winter and offers the still via the button. No reverse flight.
integration_contract.rapid_next: Loading retains accumulated wheel input. Button during scrub continues; during auto playback it skips. No invisible seasons are queued.
integration_contract.interruption: Menu cancels video and uses latest available requested still; no intermediate flights.
integration_contract.keyboard_and_reduced_motion: Go directly to target still. Escape/Skip finishes an active flight. Retain control focus and announce only settled season.
integration_contract.mobile: Use approved still fallback until a portrait-safe crop is checked. Desktop crop is not assumed safe.
integration_contract.acceptance: Pilot winter-autumn: exact still anchors, no hat morph or scenery warp, smooth seam, working skip and slow/offline fallback. Geographical continuity remains unverified until actual video review.
integration_contract.audio: Separate opt-in local wind track from the user-supplied island reference, quiet gain with 60ms rise and 100ms fall; pauses when camera motion stops.
